messages:
maria: Quick question — as we wire up the auto-fallback policy in the console, how do folks feel about surfacing an "explain" row for each routed request? Thinking: a short human-readable reason + link to the audit playback.
ashok: Love the idea. We should be careful about PII in the reason text though. Maybe a policy-id + normalized reason enum (e.g., "latency_spike", "quota_exceeded", "model_error") and a tooltip that expands to a sanitized sentence. :thinking:
ryan: Agree on enums. From API side we can add two fields to route_response: fallback_reason (enum) and fallback_evidence_url (signed short-lived). That keeps the payload small.
kim: For the console UX: show the enum as a pill, color-coded by severity, and include a play icon if playback exists. We should also allow ops to "copy forensic link" to send to SRE.
maria: Nice. Also want an audit mode that can replay the decision tree for a sampled subset of requests — not full replay for privacy/rate reasons. We should let users toggle sampling by service or model.
ashok: Sampling control should tie into quotas — if playback sampling increases downstream storage, we should warn before toggling. Maybe a quota delta estimate in the toggle confirmation.
ryan: Implementation note: fallback_evidence_url should expire in 1h by default. We can add a signed token that also encodes the sampling_id so the playback service knows which bits are allowed.
kim: UX question: when a fallback happens because of a model variant mismatch (e.g., GPU->CPU quantized variant), do we show more detail? I'd prefer a collapsed "technical" section that only users with org-level role can expand.
maria: Yes — default view is high-level. Expand for tech details (model_variant, latency_ms, error_code). We must log both the user-facing reason and the raw trigger to the audit log.
ashok: Edge case: if the fallback was chained (primary -> variant A -> fallback to fallback model), how should we show it? Flattened list or breadcrumb?
ryan: Breadcrumbs are better for triage: show the chain, timestamps, and the decision policy that fired at each step. Keep that in the audit JSON but show up as a mini-timeline in UI.
kim: Can we reuse the rollout UI's existing timeline component? Less dev work. Add a small timeline entry "auto-fallback" with the reason pill.
maria: What about exposing the policy evaluation inputs? E.g., route headers, region, customer_tier. We should be careful: sensitive headers redacted. Provide a hashed customer_id as a stable identifier for correlating across logs.
ashok: +1 to hashed id. Also recommend a retention policy for detailed audit (90 days for detailed, 365 for aggregated histograms).
ryan: Telemetry changes: add metrics fallback.count_by_reason, fallback.latency_p50/p95, fallback.chain_length_hist. That will help us set SLOs for fallback rates.
kim: From product side, let's add a console toggle: "Show fallback reasons inline" (on/off per-team). Default off to reduce noise for new users.
maria: OK action items: (1) Ryan — API fields spec for fallback_reason + evidence URL + chain (due Friday). (2) Ashok — privacy/sanitization rules doc + hashed id scheme. (3) Kim — mockups for timeline + pill + playback CTA. I'll coordinate sampling/quotas with finance.
ryan: I'll post an API PR link once draft exists.
ashok: I'll sketch the sanitization rules and post a short checklist.
kim: Mockups incoming — will drop PNG and a short Loom.
dev-bot: deploy:infra-service/rollout-audit v1.9.2 started by @ci (2345678920)
ops-bot: alert: test-playback-queue processing delay 12s — investigating (2345678925)
maria: Thanks — if playback queue delay persists, we should gate the "play" button with a tooltip and allow manual retry. :thumbsup:
ryan: Noted. we'll surface queue health in the playback modal footer.
maria: Great, thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after mockups + API draft.
